description:
Full Stack Web Developer
Houston, TX
Full Time
Entry Level
 SHARE

Job Summary:

This role designs, develops, documents, tests, implements, and debugs new and existing software solutions for large-scale proprietary software for internal use. Serves as a technical expert on development projects. Participates in the full development life cycle, including requirements analysis and design. Writes technical specifications based on conceptual design and stated business requirements. Supports, maintains, and documents software functionality. Identifies and evaluates new technologies for implementation. Analyzes components to find causes of errors and revise programs as needed. Analyzes user needs, system requirements, and business processes to determine technical requirements. Consults with end user to prototype, refine, test, and debug components to meet needs.

Responsibilities:

10%, Analyzes user needs, system requirements, and business processes
25%, Maintain the source code for existing software products, participate in code reviews, software design and development process
25%, Develop customized applications for company internal use
15%, Identify and debug source cause of issues
15%, Provide issue resolution through configuration or code changes
10%, Perform or support product installations, upgrades, and updates

Skills/Qualifications:

Python (3.6 and higher) programmer candidates, 1 - 3 years of development experience
Experience with front-end development using technologies such as JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax, and CSS
Django Framework 6.0 programmer candidates at least 1 year of development experience
RESTful API’s programmer candidates, at least 1 year of development experience
Database development using Oracle, SQL Server 2019 and higher, PostgreSQL 15+
Advanced knowledge and experience with Linux (CentOS, RedHat, Ubuntu) and Windows Server (2019 and higher). Including: IIS, PowerShell, Command Prompt and batch file scripting (desired not required)
Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and experience integrating AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Azure AI, or similar APIs) into applications
Experience with automation scripting and process optimization using Python (e.g., task automation, data processing, or workflow automation)
Familiarity with tools or frameworks for automation and integration (such as Celery, cron jobs, or CI/CD pipelines)
Exposure to prompt engineering or building AI-assisted features (e.g., chatbots, document processing, or intelligent workflows) is a plus
Knowledge of data handling for AI applications (e.g., JSON processing, text preprocessing, or API-based data pipelines)
Familiarity with LLM-based application development (e.g., building AI-powered features such as document summarization, search, or workflow assistants)
Excellent communication, organization, and interpersonal skills
Excellent problem-solving skills with extreme attention to detail
Outstanding work ethic and commitment to individual and organizational success
Excellent analytical and advanced troubleshooting skills with end-users/clients
Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects, both independently and as part of a team
Demonstrated ability to learn new things and continuously drive process improvement.

Plus/Desired:

Experience with Git Repositories (GITLAB) or JIRA
Containerization using Docker.

Educational Requirements:

Bachelor degree in a business or IT-related area, IT Security-related classes a plus, BS in Computer Science a plus.
Any software programming certifications are a plus.
